# snipeit_group (Resource)

Manages a permission group in Snipe-IT.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "snipeit_group" "helpdesk" {
  name = "Helpdesk"
  permissions = {
    "assets.view"     = "1"
    "assets.checkin"  = "1"
    "assets.checkout" = "1"
    "users.view"      = "1"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the group. Must be unique.

### Optional

- `notes` (String) Free-form notes.
- `permissions` (Map of String) Permission map of the group, e.g. `{ "assets.view" = "1" }`. Values are `"1"` (allow), `"0"` (inherit/deny) or `"-1"` (explicit deny). Snipe-IT stores exactly the submitted map and an update replaces it entirely, so this attribute round-trips without drift. After `terraform import` the attribute is null; the next apply with a configured map takes it over.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric id of the group.
